  <h1 id="references-title">Search, check, ask</h1>

  <div class="resource-actions" aria-label="Quick links">

  <div><span>R</span><p>Check help</p></div>
  <div><span>Q</span><p>Test an example</p></div>

  <section class="resource-section" aria-labelledby="where-title">
  <div class="resource-section__header">
  <h2 id="where-title">Where to search?</h2>
  <p>The right place depends on the problem. Start with the source closest to your need, then broaden if needed.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="reading-map">
  <article><h3>Local R help</h3><p>Use <code>?function</code>, <code>help(function)</code>, <code>example(function)</code> and <code>args(function)</code> in the console.</p></article>
  <article><h3>Course pages</h3><p>Return to modules, the toolbox, datasets and packages before searching more broadly.</p></article>
  <article><h3>Official documentation</h3><p>Prefer package sites and official guides to check arguments and examples.</p></article>
  <article><h3>Forum and human help</h3><p>When you remain stuck, prepare a short question with minimal code and the full error message.</p></article>
  </div>
  </section>

  <section class="resource-section resource-split" aria-labelledby="question-title">
  <div>
  <h2 id="question-title">Ask a good question</h2>
  <p>A good question makes the problem observable. It helps the teaching assistant, instructor, a peer or the AI assistant understand what is happening.</p>
  <ol class="clean-steps">
  <li>Say what you wanted to obtain.</li>
  <li>Show the minimal code that produces the problem.</li>
  <li>Copy the full error message.</li>
  <li>Say what you already tried.</li>
  <li>Indicate the module, challenge or exercise involved.</li>
  </ol>
  </div>
  <div class="resource-compact-list" aria-label="Weak and useful reflexes">
  <article class="resource-compact"><h3>Too vague</h3><p>"It does not work" does not provide enough information to help.</p></article>
  <article class="resource-compact"><h3>Useful</h3><p>"I want to filter these rows, but <code>filter()</code> returns this error" allows diagnosis.</p></article>
  <article class="resource-compact"><h3>Verifiable</h3><p>A small data excerpt or reproducible example is better than an isolated screenshot.</p></article>
  </div>
  </section>

  <section class="resource-section" aria-labelledby="external-title">
  <div class="resource-section__header">
  <h2 id="external-title">Useful external references</h2>
  <p>These links help check a function, deepen a concept or compare examples.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="resource-hub-grid">
  <article class="resource-hub-card"><h3>R for Data Science</h3><p>Free guide on importing, transforming, visualizing and communicating with R.</p><a href="https://r4ds.hadley.nz/">Open the book</a></article>
  <article class="resource-hub-card"><h3>Quarto</h3><p>Official documentation for reports, slides, websites and rendering options.</p><a href="https://quarto.org/docs/">Open the documentation</a></article>
  <article class="resource-hub-card"><h3>dplyr</h3><p>Function reference for filtering, selecting, creating, grouping and summarizing data.</p><a href="https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/">Open the reference</a></article>
  <article class="resource-hub-card"><h3>ggplot2</h3><p>Function reference for building graphics with the layered grammar.</p><a href="https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/">Open the reference</a></article>
  <article class="resource-hub-card"><h3>Posit Community</h3><p>Help forum for R, RStudio, Quarto, Shiny and the tidyverse.</p><a href="https://forum.posit.co/">Open the forum</a></article>
  <article class="resource-hub-card"><h3>Stack Overflow</h3><p>Question and answer archive useful for precise errors, to use with critical judgment.</p><a href="https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/r">View R questions</a></article>
  </div>
  </section>
